privacy.included: public post/comment text, canonical note IDs/URLs, generalized public location, public engagement counts, comment relationships, completion and pagination evidence
privacy.excluded: browser profiles, cookies, signed access URLs/xsec tokens, media URLs, crawler logs, proxy/egress details, account/device identifiers, nicknames, and raw author/commenter identifiers
privacy.text_method: PII patterns redacted in newly exported Beijing, Shanghai, and Wuhan text; author/commenter identifiers HMAC-pseudonymized with keys kept outside Git

limitations: The five regional worklists contain 10,778 distinct note IDs; no cross-region target duplicates were found.
757 targets across the five regions have a completed ledger outcome but no accessible post body at collection time.
Wuhan is the only region with unresolved work: one login-expired target and 53 targets not started.
Chengdu's published audit gives aggregate comment counts and states that all accessible top-level comments/replies were collected, but its package does not include per-thread pagination rows.
Guangzhou reports 122 dangling parent relationships; these observed replies are preserved and flagged rather than inferred.
